_comment: Owner-confirmed rebalance/deploy log for the agentic cash account (••••3900). The agent APPENDS one record per confirmed deploy/rebalance (see AGENTIC.md); build-data.mjs grades each vs live quotes + SPY and attaches it as data.agentic.decisions for the consumer's Rebalance Log card. priceAt = the fill price; spyAt = SPY at decision time (null = not recorded, e.g. the seed → graded on absolute return only).

decisions.rationale: Deployed the added cash after a fresh research refresh (adversarial verify passed only LLY/JPM/NVDA as buys). Earnings-blackout deferred MSFT (7/29) and V (7/28); AMZN dropped from the target; GOOGL held near target. Placed LLY/GE/SPY/NVDA as fractional dollar-market buys queued for the open; the JPM $285 buy was blocked by the harness classifier and left pending (~$285 + ~$10 buffer stays in cash).

Initial deployment of the agentic cash account into the first research target — 8-name sector-diversified basket (SPY ballast + megacap quality). Seed record: entries are the account's actual average cost basis; SPY benchmark not recorded at seed time (absolute-return grading only).
